launch_readiness.rule: Materialize and checksum the pinned source artifacts before sampling. Every selected language must resolve to the locked corpus; missing sources fail closed and are never replaced.

architecture.E1_control: true dense Transformer; no router or MoE auxiliary losses
architecture.moe_placement_for_E_gt_1: replace every dense FFN with an MoE FFN
architecture.initialization: Megatron normal initialization with standard deviation 0.02
architecture.token_drop_policy: dropless; any observed dropped token invalidates the run
architecture.precision: BF16 parameters and computation, FP32 optimizer moments

language_sets.hash_definition: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 concatenation of each ordered language-script ID followed by a newline

K200.definition: ATLAS 50v0 plus the deterministic top-150 remaining FineWeb2 languages by train-document availability

fineweb2_rehydration.policy: apply the pinned FineWeb2 up_to_10_reps weights wherever upstream released them before language-mixture sampling
fineweb2_rehydration.missing_weights_policy: fail closed except for source-lock-pinned explicit identity overrides

explicit_identity_overrides.hau_Latn: multiplier 1 because the subset was added after upstream generated its per-language weights and no Hausa filtering-rate distribution was released

fineweb2_rehydration.english_exception: English comes from the separately pinned FineWeb corpus and is not rehydrated

data_policy.script_policy: one representative script per ISO language; choose the script with the largest frozen train-word inventory before availability ranking

language_sampling.availability_unit: estimated post-final-validation rehydration-weighted tokenizer token exposure

availability_estimator.method: per-language tokenizer-fertility sample scaled by frozen full UTF-8 inventory
availability_estimator.final_validation_rule: min(20,000,000 tokens, 20% of estimated unique language tokens)
availability_estimator.estimated_train_token_rule: estimated unique tokens minus the capped final-validation estimate
availability_estimator.rehydration_multiplier: token-weighted mean over the calibration sample
availability_estimator.english_byte_inventory_exception: reported words times the frozen calibration bytes-per-word ratio

language_sampling.realized_token_accounting: selected and exposure token counts are measured exactly in release artifacts
language_sampling.within_language_document_order: ascending SHA-256 of sampling_seed, split namespace, and stable original document ID
language_sampling.overshoot_policy: stop after reaching the token target and report whole-document overshoot

selection_inventory.role: frozen input that produced the committed top-150 audit; pinned production inventory has unchanged top-150 membership, order, and cutoff

tokenizer_policy.language_availability_estimator: pinned full post-reserve document inventory times deterministic pilot unique train sentences per train document; exact for exhausted sources
tokenizer_policy.language_probability_rehydration_rule: FineWeb2 rehydration does not change tokenizer language probabilities and acts only within language
tokenizer_policy.acquisition_protocol: pilot, frozen quotas, then immutable per-language rebuild with a 1.10 document/byte planning floor and exact train-side weighted sentence-slot stopping
tokenizer_policy.sentence_slot_counter: sum over train documents of deterministic sentence count times the pinned within-language rehydration multiplier
tokenizer_policy.non_exhausted_stop_rule: document, byte, calibration, and required weighted sentence-slot minima must all be met
tokenizer_policy.artificial_pilot_cycling: forbidden; cycling is allowed only after proven complete pinned-source exhaustion

validation_policy.candidate_reserve_rule: withhold a deterministic seed-42 whole-document superset before tokenizer training; after the final tokenizer exists, select the exact target panel and return every unused candidate to the model-training selection pool with its pinned rehydration multiplier
validation_policy.candidate_adequacy_gate: fail before H100 work if the candidate pool cannot reach the exact final-token target for any language
validation_policy.per_language_target: min(20,000,000 tokens, 20% of unique post-filter language tokens)
validation_policy.unigram_reference: unique training-only non-special token counts; pseudo-count one only for unseen non-special vocabulary IDs
validation_policy.training_eod_target_policy: include EOD prediction in the training language-model loss
validation_policy.validation_target_domain: score every real non-special validation target; exclude all frozen special-token targets, including EOD, from both raw NLL and unigram-adjusted loss
validation_policy.validation_eod_context_policy: retain EOD in the packed input/context stream so it still marks document boundaries
validation_policy.validation_final_partial_sequence_policy: right-pad the final partial sequence, mask padding, and retain every real non-special target
validation_policy.K1_absent_languages: evaluate the frozen K200-minus-English panel as zero_shot, report separately, and exclude it from the trained-language primary aggregate
validation_policy.evaluation_timing: evaluate every final-20%-decayed D checkpoint used by the fit

training_policy.learning_rate_rule: fixed peak learning rate 2e-4 across every N, E, and K cell; no learning-rate calibration or selection
training_policy.learning_rate_limitation: the common literature-backed rate is controlled across cells but is not claimed to be optimal for every model size or expert count
training_policy.schedule: warmup, stable, then linear decay to zero over the final 20% of D_max
training_policy.readout_protocol: save a full model+optimizer+scheduler+RNG checkpoint at 0.8D, branch from that exact state, and decay linearly to zero at D

micro_batch_policy.rule: within each batch-ramp segment, MBS=min(cell plateau MBS, GBS) and gradient accumulation=GBS/MBS on DP=1
micro_batch_policy.plateau_mbs: 64 for every A cell and B/E1,E4,E16; 32 for B/E32 because of measured H100 memory limits
micro_batch_policy.resulting_steps: MBS/GA is 32/1,64/1,64/2 for plateau-64 cells and 32/1,32/2,32/4 for B/E32
micro_batch_policy.scientific_caveat: global tokens per optimizer update are controlled, but MoE auxiliary statistics are formed at microbatch granularity; report the B/E32 MBS exception

fixed_learning_rate_verification.schedule: linear warmup to the fixed 2e-4 peak learning rate, then constant peak learning rate

invalid_if: required full-state checkpoint is missing or corrupt
any required per-language evaluation is missing
the pre-tokenizer validation candidate pool cannot realize the exact final-token target
any token is dropped by MoE routing
configuration or artifact hashes differ from the frozen plan
scientific_observations_not_automatic_ex: router imbalance or collapse without token dropping
low MFU after the predeclared efficiency gate
run_validity_policy.provenance: retain every failed attempt and exclusion reason
